$comment: jimbo-ui's own catalogue: the shared components (foundation, kit, pattern) and the generic candidates an app has built that may join the kit. Which apps use each is not stored here — each app lists that in its own jimbo-ui.json, and scripts/inventory.mjs puts it together. Match by purpose, not name; see the guide's "One library, no duplicates". Names and paths only — never app code.

tiers.candidate: Built in an app, generic — may be promoted
tiers.domain: Stays in the app: listed only in that app's jimbo-ui.json (components.local), never here

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Triggers an action; one primary per view.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.purpose: Picks one colour inline without the platform's colour dialog.

components.name: .card
components.purpose: Groups related content on a raised surface.

components.name: .field
components.purpose: Takes typed input from the user.

components.name: .label
components.purpose: Names a form field.

components.name: .chip
components.purpose: Shows a small tag or a toggleable filter.

components.name: .dot-*
components.purpose: Marks something with one theme colour as a flat circle.

components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: Frames every page: top bar with the app's name, floating tab dock, pull to refresh.

components.name: TopBarButton
components.purpose: Puts a page-wide action (search, add) in the top bar.

components.name: DockIcon
components.purpose: Draws a tab's icon in the dock.

components.name: HeaderTitle
components.purpose: Shows the app's name as its brand, with a dot in the accent.

components.name: JimboConfigPage
components.purpose: Holds every brand, theme and style guide option for the app, in one place at /jimbo-ui.

variants.canConfigure: boolean (admin check, or true with no auth)

components.name: ThemeCard
components.purpose: Shows a theme as a miniature of the app to choose from.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Shows a status as a short coloured label.

variants.dot: a status dot before the label (was VolumeChip)

components.name: TONES / Tone
components.purpose: Maps an app's statuses onto the fixed set of tones.

variants.tone: accent | highlight | support | yellow | purple | red | muted

components.name: STATUS_DOT
components.purpose: Shows a row's status as a small flat circle.

components.name: Chevron
components.purpose: Signals that a row opens something.

components.name: ThemeDots
components.purpose: Shows the theme's colours as the motif: circles, or the theme's motif shape.

components.name: FullBleed
components.purpose: Runs a section edge to edge.

components.name: HeroSection
components.purpose: Opens a page with a big title over a pattern, no photo.

components.name: PageHeader
components.purpose: Titles an index page.

components.name: BackButton
components.purpose: Goes back to the page before.

components.name: Banner
components.purpose: Opens a detail page over a blurred photo, full width.

components.name: Hero
components.purpose: Opens a detail page with its image and title.

components.name: ImageViewer
components.purpose: Shows images full screen.

variants.items: proposed: several images with swipe between them (PhotoCarousel)

components.name: Section
components.purpose: Holds one titled block of content.

components.name: List
components.purpose: Holds rows in one card.

components.name: ListGroupLabel
components.purpose: Starts a group of rows (a month, a kind).

components.name: DateBlock
components.purpose: Shows a date as a tear-off calendar ticket.

components.name: EventRow
components.purpose: Shows a dated item in a list, with its status.

variants.onOpen: opens something in place instead of a link (was RunRow)

components.name: EntityRow
components.purpose: Shows a named thing (a person, a place) with an avatar.

variants.avatarText: A short code or number in the placeholder avatar

components.name: MediaCard
components.purpose: Leads with an image in a grid.

components.name: MediaGrid
components.purpose: Lays out MediaCards in a grid at a chosen card size.

components.name: LinkCard
components.purpose: Navigates somewhere, as a card.

components.name: StatTile
components.purpose: Shows one headline number.

variants.size: proposed: sm — a compact cell for admin summaries (dl stat grids)
variants.trend: number[] — a Sparkline under the number

components.name: StatGrid
components.purpose: Lays out headline numbers.

components.name: RankedList
components.purpose: Shows a top-N with counts.

components.name: SearchField
components.purpose: Searches or filters as you type.

components.name: RangeField
components.purpose: Sets a number with a labelled slider.

components.name: SelectField
components.purpose: Picks one option from many.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switches between 2–4 views of one thing.

variants.size: md | sm (inline, for a section's action slot)

components.name: PillTabs
components.purpose: Filters by one of several values.

components.name: Pager
components.purpose: Pages through a long list.

components.name: Sheet
components.purpose: The one modal: bottom sheet on phones, dialog on desktop.

components.name: Loading
components.purpose: Shows a page-shaped skeleton while data loads.

components.name: EmptyState
components.purpose: Says what's missing and offers the next step.

components.name: ThemeScope
components.purpose: Shows part of a page in another theme without changing the rest.

components.name: MapView
components.purpose: Shows places on a map in the theme's colours.

components.name: MapPinCard
components.purpose: Shows the chosen place on a map page, above the dock.

components.name: ViewSwitch
components.purpose: Switches between two or three views of one page as links.

components.name: useUrlState
components.purpose: Keeps a view's tab, filter, search or page in the URL, so refresh, Back and links land on the same view.

components.name: Save bar
components.purpose: Offers Undo / Save above the dock while there's something unsaved.

components.name: OfflineBanner
components.purpose: Says the app is offline and how many changes are waiting.

components.name: Background work ring
components.purpose: Shows background work (uploads, syncing) as a progress ring in a corner, with pause and cancel.

components.name: Select mode
components.purpose: Turns rows into toggles with a floating action bar.

components.name: KeyValue
components.purpose: Shows a read-only label and its value.

variants.layout: inline (label left, value right) | stacked (label above)

components.name: Autocomplete
components.purpose: Picks an existing record as you type, or makes a new one.

components.name: SwitchRow
components.purpose: Turns one setting on or off, as a row with a label and a hint.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.purpose: Shows how far along a known-length job is.

components.name: BarChart
components.purpose: Compares counts across a few categories as bars.

components.name: TrendChart
components.purpose: Shows how one to three amounts change over time.

variants.series: 1–3, tones in order accent · support · highlight

components.name: Sparkline
components.purpose: Shows a small trend with no axes.

components.name: LayoutSwitch
components.purpose: Lets people show a list as rows or tiles, and remembers it.

components.name: Heatmap
components.purpose: Shows how often something happens across a grid of days or weeks.

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: Shows milestones in order along a line.

components.name: ShareButton
components.purpose: Makes an image of something and opens the share sheet.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.purpose: Shows raw text (a log, a config) in monospace, wrapped.

variants.follow: stays scrolled to the end while it grows

components.name: Verdict
components.purpose: Answers "is everything fine?" in one line before the details.

components.name: CheckHistory
components.purpose: The last few up/down checks of something as a row of 8 px dots, oldest first, with empty slots for checks not made yet.

components.name: ToggleGrid
components.purpose: Picks several options from a small fixed set, as a wrapping grid of toggle buttons.

components.name: LinkChips
components.purpose: Links to related things as a wrapping row of chips, each with an optional colour dot and short second label.

components.name: FloatingBar
components.purpose: Shows a status and its actions in a bar floating above the dock.

variants.live: Pulsing accent dot while something runs

components.name: TextField
components.purpose: Takes one line of typed input with its label, hint and inline error.

components.name: TextArea
components.purpose: Takes several lines of typed input, growing with the text.

components.name: DateField
components.purpose: Picks a date, a time or both with the platform's own picker.

components.name: FileDrop
components.purpose: Picks or takes dropped files, checking type and size.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: Offers a short list of actions on one thing from a button.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Shows a few controls by their button without leaving the page.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Labels an icon-only control on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.purpose: App-wide search (Spotlight, ⌘K): live results from the app's search providers with thumbnails, a preview pane, facet:value filter chips, recent picks and suggestions; commands go to a page or run an action.

components.name: SearchTrigger
components.purpose: A button that looks like a search field and opens the app-wide search (an explore page's search bar).

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Says briefly that something happened, with one action at most.

components.name: ConfirmSheet
components.purpose: Asks before a destructive or surprising action, saying what survives.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: Shows where you are in a flow of a few steps.

variants.onStep: go back to a done step

components.name: UpdateBanner
components.purpose: Says a new version is ready and offers to reload.

components.name: DataTable
components.purpose: Shows many records with several facts each, sortable, as rows on phones.

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Folds away sections most people won't need.
